title: ExternalEventMapping - Data API
description: Holds native iOS or Android calendar event details for the Salesforce Today feature in the Salesforce mobile app. This object is available in API version 35.0 and later.

EndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EndDate.description: The date the external event ends.

EventId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EventId.description: The ID of the Salesforce event created by the external event. This field is a relationship field.

ExternalId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalId.description: The ID of the external event.

IsLocked.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsLocked.description: Returns true if the external event is locked, or false if it’s not. The default value is false.

IsRecurring.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsRecurring.description: Indicates whether the external event is recurring (true) or not (fales). The default value is false.

MayEdit.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
MayEdit.notes: Indicates whether the external event can be edited (true) or not (false).; The default value is false.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the external event’s organizer.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the creator of the external event. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

StartDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
StartDate.description: The date the external event begins.

special_access_rules: The Salesforce Today app is available in Salesforce for Android and Salesforce for iOS. It’s not available in the Salesforce desktop site. Access to Today is available only if you grant Calendar permission to the Salesforce mobile app.
